claims.statement: Tom Allen, a British fighter, settled in St. Louis in the sixties.

claims.statement: After retiring, Tom Allen opened a saloon on Market Street near Seventh.

claims.statement: Tom Allen named his saloon Champion's Rest and ran it until his death early this century.
